entries.title: Complete Perpendicular Jointer and Planer Workarea
entries.description: One complete static woodworking surface-preparation workarea, one scene and zero new independent models. The entire original long-bed jointer stands at the left with its bed axis running front-to-back and visibly open end zones. A whole original open worktable occupies a separate right rear station; the complete qualified thickness planer rests on its four original pads, with its through-feed axis perpendicular to the jointer and its original extension tables and side crank preserved. The machine pad contacts lie inside the real tabletop, while the small side crank may project beyond the tabletop edge. A central open floor strip separates the ground machine from the table, rather than the old paired-sawhorse plank or the joint-sample/plane tabletop with rear tool rack. All three original GLB buffers, local POSITION/NORMAL, material dictionaries, face assignments and internal hierarchy are byte-preserved. Only whole unit-scale exact quarter-turn rotations, translations and one finite scene-only floor are new. No old component is extracted, recoloured or counted as a new model. No timber, feeding path, connected machinery, cutting, power, dust collection, professional workflow, human reach, load, installation or safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction not made.

entries.title: Whole Cactus Rosette and Tortoise Clearing

The tall rear silhouette and low side planting frame the entire visible tortoise without placing it inside plants or changing its limbs. One closed finite sandy floor is scene-only; a clear front strip remains. All original oriented world triangles and per-face opaque PBR are retained, only whole translations and float32 storage; original hierarchy/normals are baked/recomputed and no GLB-byte identity is claimed. Zero new reusable models, one scene. This is neither the old well/palm/canopy/bench oasis nor the mudbrick/packframe/cargo court with more plants. Static artistic arrangement only, not a claim of exact species co-occurrence, habitat, animal care, food, climate suitability, shade performance, locomotion, navigation, simulation or safety.

entries.title: Fixed Split Hip Pad and Rear Roller Extension Bench
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed back-extension-bench exterior. A full low tie and steep front stay triangulate the open frame above two broad transverse ground feet. No long back cushion, seated carriage, weights, hinged seat, or slant-board deck is reused. All new numeric geometry, one complete prop and zero scenes, four opaque solid PBR roles, metres Z up, full horizontal bounds centred and finite feet at ground. entries.title: Fixed Offset Pin and Vertical Slot Yoke Display
entries.description: One newly authored whole static direct-pin slotted-yoke-style display. A complete narrow tall frame has a genuine vertical through slot and two integral horizontal stems, passing through two whole bored guide pedestals on a common grounded bed. Behind that frame one entire circular crank disc carries a separate eccentric pin through the slot and a proud retaining head. A full rear spindle, genuinely bored bearing pedestal and retaining cap complete the assembly. Unlike the old crosshead drive, there is no piston cylinder, inclined two-eye connecting rod or separate flywheel; unlike the old indexing display there is no radial multi-slot wheel or second rotating shaft. All visible geometry newly authored, not old drive parts extracted or a carrier swapped. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up and whole centred ground datum, one prop zero scenes. entries.title: Fixed Cranked Nested Slotted Drum Siren
entries.description: One newly authored complete static hand-cranked theatrical-siren-style exterior. A broad ground base supports a low upright gear-case housing with a full offset crank and separate hand grip. One horizontal continuous shaft extends forward through a complete annular mounting plate into a genuinely open-ended thick stationary drum with twelve real longitudinal windows. A separate smaller complete windowed rotor is nested inside with visible radial and axial air clearance; four integral-looking front spokes meet its central hub and full shaft. The stationary drum has a separate lower grounded stay, not floating around the rotor. All drum windows are actual finite through openings in connected shared-vertex shells, not black painted stripes. This is not a toothed wooden reed ratchet, twin carding drums or those old parts moved together: every numeric part is newly authored. One whole prop zero scenes, four opaque solid PBR roles, metres Z up, horizontally centred and grounded. Static theatrical prop exterior only, no functional gearing, rotation, airflow, acoustic output, alarm effectiveness, hearing safety, emergency warning, manufacture or operating capability. entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed anchor-and-tooth-wheel exhibit.
